title: Phân tích chính sách nông nghiệp nông thôn

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature, structure, and cycle of rural agricultural policies; grasp concepts and methods for analyzing production and consumption of agricultural products.
Apply cost-benefit analysis and cost-effectiveness analysis to evaluate the effectiveness of agricultural policies.
Use economic modeling tools to predict and evaluate future scenarios of policies.
Determine the value of agricultural products using commodity valuation methods.
Implement risk management tools to minimize risks in agricultural operations.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and apply results of policy analysis effectively.
Enhance self-directed learning abilities and take responsibility for analyzing and applying results of policy analysis.
Improve presentation skills to effectively present detailed and logical reports on policy proposals or adjustments.
